title: Create authenticated Foundation policy-waiver authority
description:
AUTHORITY-GRANTING FOLLOW-UP split from task-064b97584aff4e07967738f79134a723 after task-e74d3116cbeb4abb96becb08b5896c8e explicitly ruled that Foundation currently has no waiver and no humanApprovalRef mapping.

OBJECTIVE: only after an explicit human product decision, add the authenticated human-approval record, durable writer, strict reader, and validation required to produce a scoped, expiring, SOFT-only PolicyWaiver.

DELIVERABLE: a production human action writes an immutable approval record; the waiver reader joins it to project/principal/action/obligation/scope, rejects expiry or foreign identity, and policy.validate consumes only verified waivers.

NOT IN SCOPE: policy-risk tier classification, autoApprovalOptIns, fabricating humanApprovalRef, waiving HARD obligations or required facts, lifting HOLD_UNKNOWN, or relaxing admission/budget gates.

SAFETY ORDERING: this row is not a prerequisite to delivering the fail-closed resolved-empty waiver behavior in task-064. It is required before any future live non-empty Foundation waiver can be accepted. Keep it BLOCKED until the human authorizes the record and authenticated action.

VERIFICATION COMMAND: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`; the fresh foreground output must contain nonzero Test Files and Tests lines and exit 0.
definitionOfDone: Before source edits, a durable Moe comment records the human-approved approval-record contract, authenticated human action and writer, strict reader, humanApprovalRef derivation, project/principal/action/obligation/scope join keys, expiry semantics, and revocation/supersession rule; absent that decision, the task reports BLOCKED.

Production code creates waiver authority only from an authenticated human action and a durable immutable record; caller-carried waiver fields or approval references are refused before any authority read with exact stable reason code and refusing layer.

The strict reader accepts only unexpired, same-project, same-principal/action, exact-obligation, nonempty-scope, SOFT-only approvals and distinguishes missing, unreadable, stale, revoked, and foreign records without granting authority.
policy.validate consumes the verified waiver reader; resolved-empty remains the result when no approval exists, and no waiver can suppress a HARD obligation, required fact, or HOLD_UNKNOWN.

Focused TDD covers the valid record and every hostile constructibility case, asserts exact code and layer, proves a nonzero generated roster, and includes production mutation drills for expiry, scope, SOFT-only, and humanApprovalRef binding.
`pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` runs standalone in the foreground, exits 0, and prints nonzero Test Files and Tests counts; `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` also exits 0.
taskRails: This row grants new human-approval authority. No architect or worker may choose the record, authenticated command, join keys, scope, expiry, or revocation semantics without an explicit human decision on a durable Moe surface.
No fabricated humanApprovalRef, demo/fixture approval, caller-carried waiver, or unrelated approval/recovery record may be repurposed.
Waivers are scoped, expiring, human-approved, and SOFT-only; they never lift HOLD_UNKNOWN or waive required facts/HARD obligations.
TDD, exact refusal code and layer, per-production-file size caps, and explicit-pathspec commits apply.
